verdict.rationale: Make's docs show event-driven triggering: custom webhooks create a URL that external apps or other scenarios call to trigger scenario execution, and webhook requests can be queued and processed on a schedule. Evidence for defining conditional rules (filters, routers, condition logic) that decide which actions fire is thin, and the trigger types documented are limited to webhooks. missing for 10: documented rule/condition definition (filters, routers), event triggers beyond webhooks (e.g., app-native instant triggers), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: webhooks create a url that you can call from an external app or service, or from another use webhooks to trigger the execution
